title: T. rex took 40 years to reach full size, scientists find

title: As lakes turn brown, trout and bass decline while pike and walleye thrive

Meanwhile, walleye and northern pike often become more abundant because they are better adapted to low-visibility conditions. The shift could change both lake ecosystems and the fishing experience for millions of anglers.
